The road fully reopened at around 4am on Tuesday In a statement, a Merseyside Police spokesperson said: "At around 9.55pm, we received a report of a collision involving a van and a lorry northbound between junctions 23 (Newton-le-Willows) and 24 (Ashton-in-Makerfield).
